question_text: A government employee posted a critical comment on social media about her agency's policies. She was subsequently suspended for violating the agency's code of conduct. She claims her right to freedom of speech was violated. Under Article III of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is correct?

options.text: Freedom of speech is absolute and cannot be restricted by any government agency.
Government employees have no right to freedom of speech because they are public servants.
Freedom of speech may be subject to reasonable regulations, especially for government employees, to ensure efficiency and discipline.
The suspension is automatically unconstitutional because it restricts speech.
